passage.t: Crop rotation is a farming technique that involves growing a series of different types of crops in the same area across a sequence of seasons. Different crops use different nutrients from the soil, so rotating them prevents the soil from becoming depleted.
. Farmers use this practice to improve crop yields and maintain healthy soil.

tasks.analysis: Crop rotation is a farming technique that involves growing a series of different types of crops in the same area across a sequence of seasons. Different crops use different nutrients from the soil, so rotating them prevents the soil from becoming depleted. This method helps to reduce pests and diseases; it also decreases the need for chemical fertilizers, promoting sustainable agriculture.
